title: micranthes stellaris
intro: Micranthes stellaris, commonly known as Stellar Saxifrage, is a flowering plant species in the saxifrage family (Saxifragaceae). It is native to the mountainous regions of China, Japan, and Korea. The health benefits of Micranthes stellaris include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and inflammation, due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
